input.summary:
C bedrooms (part 17) furnished in parts/room-11.mjs: a dressing table focal piece on the north wall with a standing lantern, a chair, a dark-oak wardrobe on the east wall, a side table, and 5 hanging lanterns.
Light: all 64 floor cells at 8+ (min 8, 0 dark, 0 dim); the stair well x20..21 z19..23 is kept clear. make.sh whole, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE for this part.
No bed: palette.json has no beds, carpets, candles or barrels, so the bedroom has no bed. Walk verdict UNREACHABLE because the stairs part (stub in this copy) is not built.
left: No bed. palette.json has no bed block (beds with part foot/head are the bedroom's focal piece). Add beds to the palette, and carpets, to finish; the room is otherwise furnished without them.

Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE (0 of 64 cells) in this copy: the only way in is the stair well x20..21 z19..23, which the stairs part (stub here) builds. Recheck `$MCD room` after the merge; the well's foot at (20..21,13,19) is kept clear for it.
Wardrobe is a plain dark_oak_planks block, not a cupboard with trapdoor doors; the palette has no finer cupboard shape beyond spruce_trapdoor, which I did not use for time.
plan.md Notes has a line about the palette gap (beds, carpets, candles, barrels).

waste.what: Drew the room as four 11x7 layer grids and iterated lantern positions by hand: three rebuilds to clear the dim corners (x=26 at z=18..19, then z=23), each a make.sh plus a room check.
waste.cost: about 4 build cycles and 3 manual coordinate picks
waste.tool: `$MCD room` could list the dim cells with coordinates and a ready-made lantern set (it suggests only the best single spot); a `--fix-light` option that returns a legend-ready lantern list for a whole room would save the iteration.

waste.what: Checked palette membership by reading palette.json and the spec by eye. A bed, carpet, candle or barrel gap only surfaces as a missing block in the design, not at the start.
waste.cost: one read of palette.json, then a redesign of the focal piece around the missing bed
waste.tool: A palette-coverage check per room (`$MCD room --palette palette.json` or a pre-flight from the designer's ROOMS list) that flags a required furniture kind with no palette block before the layout is drawn.

waste.what: Worked out bed facing semantics (facing = direction from foot to head) from memory; no helper exposes it.
waste.cost: one reasoning pass, no retry because no bed was placed
waste.tool: A `B.bed(color, facing, part)` helper in the build library, documented with the head/foot convention.

companions.task: Supply the bed frame and carpet to the palette and place the two bedsteads (part foot/head, facing north) against the north wall, clear of the front windows at x21..22 and x25.
Confirm the stair well x20..21 z19..23 with its foot at z=19 and head at y=16, so the room's way in is walkable and the walk verdict can read OK.
Check the hanging-lantern positions against the final attic ceiling once the roof part merges, since the floor at y=17 is the lantern hanging surface.
